column5: GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - PF:9551-9569. Default (empty) qualification evidence for a missing domain definition or a non-ensures fact.
GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - PEV:1014. An `Assembly` statement never overwrites a binding: an assembly statement that writes a local between the binding and the read.
GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - PEV:2211-2221. Float-typed bindings skip the write scan, and the type is peeled through references first: a write through `&mut f64`.
GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - PEV:1296-1299; PEV:1246-1251. Arguments are paired with parameters by position without selector alignment; only `VALUES` child edges are scanned.
GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - SH:1028-1030. Product-operand selections are left unfinalized and the final unresolved check does not name them.

GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - SH:2253-2292, 2648, 1967; SH:2181-2198. Unary operators and seven binary operators settle as builtin: a user-declared overload would not be selected. Whether the language has such overloads was not checked.

GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - SH:489-491; SH:2912-2923; SH:4685-4687. The resolver's direct symbol is returned when no contextual root exists; assembly-fact roots feed the proof-view collector; a body candidate with no matching declaration is dropped.
GROUP: Published facts, shared, values: | - VA:1016-1018. `StructuralIdentity` evaluates true when both sides are equal trees: two reads of the same mutable storage at different times.
